cards.title: Define the research question
cards.text: Record the exact obligation, period, facts, forum, and opposing position before comparing authorities. Editorial scores organize reading; they do not decide the law.

cards.title: Keep judicial analysis alongside the legal text
cards.text: A judicial holding has a separate jurisdiction and precedential analysis. A private ruling cannot be placed above a court simply because it appears earlier in a document list.

cards.title: Private advice and penalty standards differ
cards.text: Private determinations are generally nonprecedential. Qualifying private rulings and technical advice can still be relevant to a distinct substantial-authority inquiry.

cards.title: Check the 2026 administrative-relief transition
cards.text: AEP begins with eligible annual 2025 and quarterly 2026 original returns. Eligible original returns due from January 1, 2027 use AEP rather than FTA. Verify processing and account facts.

cards.title: Reasonable cause requires a complete record
cards.text: An illness, lost record, or disaster label is not an automatic grant. Connect the event to the particular failure, the care exercised, and the effort to correct the failure.

cards.title: Keep unknown facts visible
cards.text: An unanswered condition produces a review task. A research result is an educational screen, not an agency decision or a calculation of a claim deadline.
